ios.title: How to install on iPhone/iPad
ios.step2: Scroll down and tap "Add to Home Screen"

android.title: How to install on Android
android.step1: Tap the menu ⋮ in the top right
android.step2: Tap "Install app" or "Add to Home Screen"

desktop.title: How to install on desktop
desktop.step1: Click the install icon in the address bar
desktop.step2: Or use the browser menu → "Install Mon Petit Cycliste"
